messages:
Aisha (PM): quick thread — want to align on a rollout pattern for the next feature batch (per-tenant routing + regional performance gates). thinking a 3-layer safety approach instead of a single canary.
Tom (Eng): sounds good. can you sketch the 3 layers? i want the dev effort estimate before we lock scope.
Aisha (PM): 1) shadow warmup (traffic mirroring, no impact) 2) safety-curtain window (limited live traffic + auto-throttle) 3) open ramp. each layer has a kill-switch and per-tenant opt-out. safety-curtain = our name for a soft live window where we enforce stricter fallbacks and shorter timeouts.
Maya (Infra): for the shadow warmup we'll need a way to mirror ~1-3% of production requests to a dedicated infra pool. that’s doable but requires routing flag + small dedicated pool. estimate ~2 infra days and tagging for cost metering.
Jorge (SRE): important: safety-curtain must enforce circuit-backoff on errors and automatically route failures to variant-v1 (the cheaper quantized model) not straight to 503. also add a 30s cooldown for any tenant that triggers >0.5% error delta.
Priya (Sales): a few enterprise customers asked for opt-in only. we should support tenant-level gates and a manual whitelist so we don't upset compliance customers during warmup.
Tom (Eng): engineering clarifications: implementing tenant gates is ~3 dev days (flag + config surface). auto-fallback to variant-v1 needs an adapter in the router to prefer compatible model variants — another 4 dev days. can we trim scope by delaying per-route telemetry? that’s non-blocking.
Aisha (PM): yes, telemetry can be rolled in post-launch as a follow-up. launch criteria if agreed: - shadow for 48h with no regression on quality metrics - safety-curtain held at 5%, 15%, 40% across regions with latency and error SLO checks - per-tenant opt-out present in console - documented rollback runbook and on-call rotations assigned
Maya (Infra): regional warmup: stagger regions by timezones. suggest EMEA -> NAM -> APAC with 6h separation and a warmup curve [5%, 20%, 60%]. need to reserve burst capacity in each region for the 60% step.
Jorge (SRE): add synthetic checks that exercise long-tail sequences (max 2k tokens) and KV-cache hit rate; if latency P95 increases by >120ms vs baseline, auto-drop region to previous step. also add an automatic downgrade to lower-precision model variant for heavy tail traffic.
Priya (Sales): can we make the per-tenant opt-out API calltable via customer support tool? i'll need that for onboarding pilot customers.
Tom (Eng): note: implementing auto-downgrade to lower-precision variant requires compatibility checks with prompt schema; we should limit that to plain text generation routes initially.
Aisha (PM): decision items for this week: - approve infra effort for shadow pool (Maya) - product signoff on safety-curtain thresholds (Aisha + Jorge) - sales list pilot tenants (Priya) - eng to confirm dev estimates and deliverables (Tom)
deploy-bot: deploy-checklist created: "tiered-safety-curtain" with entries: shadow-mirror, safety-curtain-policy, tenant-gates, fallback-adapter, rollback-runbook.
Tom (Eng): i'll break down tickets and post a concise timeline. can we have a short sync tmrw 10am to finalize thresholds?
Aisha (PM): yes — tmrw 10am. bring any risks you're worried about. quick note: keep flag names stable across Hosted/Dedicated/Private flows; use hierarchical naming: rollout.feature.tiered_safety_curtain.{region,tenant}.
Priya (Sales): thanks — i'll gather pilot list and reach out to legal on opt-out SLA language.
Jorge (SRE): i'll draft the synthetic check list and cooldown thresholds and share before the sync.
Maya (Infra): will confirm cost delta for shadow pool and reserve capacity slots by EOD.
Aisha (PM): great — if we get alignment tomorrow we target shadow-mirror launch next Tue. thanks everyone :rocket:
